rationale.campaign_length: 结构化库定位40项F78直接任务；另89项关联前身任务不是F78直接任务。
rationale.colonization: 主要是旧大陆征服与整合；殖民不是决定性循环。
rationale.complexity: 形成条件结合领土、非部落政府和宽容；形成后还要管理学院、宗教与区域整合。
rationale.dark_story: 孤儿制度被当成行政资源，部分征服地有强力治安；没有把旧文档计划视作已实装心灵控制。
rationale.difficulty: 形成前准备与形成后多条城市、贸易和征服要求并行；未作实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 多族群宽容、宗教调和、矮人矿堡和跨海商贸要求兼顾内外关系。
rationale.early_pressure: 前身国家须在巴哈尔竞争并满足宽容与25省门槛；不同前身压力不一。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 铭文魔法、哥布林火、火药军队与奇械建筑形成混合发展线。
rationale.narrative_density: 流亡、建国、半地精学院、文化议会与跨地区治理构成连续国家故事。
rationale.tall_play: 沃尔托季学院、城市职位、建筑与道路持续推动省份发展。
rationale.trade_economy: 迪文哈尔海贸、港口、矿堡、城市经济与道路贯穿任务主线。
rationale.warfare: 形成需地区领土；形成后继续推进港口、山地、矿堡与贸易节点。

identity.appearance: 1444年无F78持地开局；合格外来哥布林国家通过布尔瓦尔形成决议建立
identity.formation_scope: 外来哥布林主文化、和平、合格的非部落独立资格、至少25个指定地区省份、两组关键核心地点及人类、精灵、矮人或鹰身女妖宽容条件；符合条件的其他外来哥布林国家也可形成。决议改为F78、换树、提升政府等级并按需转君主制。

description.text:
巴哈尔是一个拥有多种语言的土地——通用语、布勒瓦尔语、精灵语、矮人语，现在还多了地精语。当地精在大流亡中初次入侵该地时，他们并没有尝试学习任何一种外语。直到他们开始从成群结队的游民过渡到国家，并更频繁地与当地人交流时，沟通问题才变得日益明显。最初，大氏族政府提议把所有现存的巴哈尔语结合起来，创造一种新的语言，但这被认为是不必要的时间和精力的浪费。

他们真正采取的解决办法是雇佣非地精，让他们把当地的语言教导给地精的行政人员、外交官和统治者，同时也鼓励其他民众跟着学习。组建一个多语言政府是确保巴哈尔人民的支持和使外交更容易的可靠方法。
description.text_en:
Bahar is a land of many languages - Common, Bulwari, Elven, Dwarven and now Goblinic as well. When goblins first invaded this region during the Exodus they made no attempts to learn any of these foreign languages. As they began transitioning from roaming hordes to proper states and interacting with the locals more frequently the problems of communication became clear as day. Initially, Overclan's government proposed the creation of a new language by combining all those present in Bahar, but it was deemed an unnecessary waste of time and effort.

The actual solution was the employment of non-goblins who taught goblin administrators, diplomats and rulers in those local languages, while encouraging all others to follow suite. Having a polylingual administration was a sure way of securing both Bahari population's support and making diplomacy easier.

description.text:
流亡地精的主要成就之一是创建了第一支地精海军。陆鲨氏族在围攻奥尔迪亚失败后建造了临时船只，很快他们的兄弟氏族拥山者也效仿了他们的做法，最终也与其他氏族分享了这一知识。然而，在巴哈尔统一之前，地精海军是迪文哈尔最弱的，他们曾多次被人类、精灵和矮人的海军击沉。直到大氏族成立，并整合了其他种族的舰船设计，地精舰队才成为迪文哈尔的常见景象。

在1600年代早期，一个地精作家「矮子」济特编写了地精历史，他声称地精曾征服两个前线——蛇脊的洞穴和东坎诺的森林，现在流亡地精已经开始征服海洋，也就是第三前线。意料之中的是，这种想法在大氏族中很流行，部分原因是其对另外两个地精航海国拜韦克和梅斯季卡尔杜当时取得成功的反应。直到今天，流亡地精们还普遍认为自己是地精的先驱，受到地精的水神——星水之神的指引。
description.text_en:
One of the major achievements of Exodus Goblins was the creation of the first goblin navy. Clan of Landshark built makeshift boats following a failed siege of Ourdia, and soon their sibling clan of Mountainhugger followed suit, eventually sharing the knowledge with other clans as well. Before the unification of Bahar however, goblin navies were the weakest in the Divenhal, having been sunk by human, elven and dwarven navies on numerous occasions. Once the Overclan formed and integrated other races' designs into their own, the goblin fleet became a common sight in the Divenhal.

During the early 1600s, a goblin writer Zyt the Short wrote a history of the goblinkind, in which he claims that goblins have previously conquered two frontiers - the caves of the Serpentspine and the forests of Escann - and that now Exodus Goblins have begun the conquest of the ocean, also known as the Third Frontier. Unsurprisingly, this thought became popular in the Overclan, partially as a reaction to recent successes of Bayvek and Mestikardu, two other seafaring goblin nations. To this day Exodus Goblins commonly believe themselves to be the pioneers of goblinkind, having been guided by Zvaiko Udenzo, goblin god of water himself.

description.text:
在地精试图与当地巴哈尔人合作的初期，劳动力成了问题。很少有人愿意为这些前入侵者工作，尤其是在官僚机构，因为这意味着要经常与地精接触。1529年，大领主德拉姆科尔克提出了一个有趣的解决方案——将孤儿培养成官僚。许多在廿年灾难、大流亡和萨玛塔尔调查期间失去所有家人的孤儿，整天在街上为生存而斗争。大氏族为这些孩子提供住处和食物，期望孩子们将来能为他们工作。

这个计划是成功的，大氏族在短短十年内组建了一支适当的官僚力量，并在随后对巴哈尔的计划中将其充分利用。

这些孤儿中有很大一部分是沃尔托季，也就是半地精，他们并不全是孤儿，也有被家人所遗弃的。当一些人类孤儿憎恨地精，把自己的处境归咎于他们时，沃尔托季们一致接受了大氏族，并将他们彼此视为新的家庭。
description.text_en:
In the beginning of goblin attempts to work together with the local Bahari population there was an issue of workforce. Very few were willing to work for these former invaders, especially in the bureaucracy, as that meant having a near constant contact with goblins. An intriguing solution was proposed by Overboss Dramkork in 1529 - raising orphans as bureaucrats. Many locals have lost their families during the Decades of Devastation, Goblin Exodus and during the Samartal investigations and were left with nothing, fighting for scraps on the streets. Overclan provided those children with shelter and food, in hopes the children would work for them.

The program was a success, with the Overclan raising a proper bureaucratic force within just a decade, which was fully utilised in the subsequent Bahari-wide programs.

A large portion of said orphans was made of Voltoj - half-goblins, who were not always orphans, but castaways from their families. While some human orphans held hatred for goblins, blaming them for their condition, Voltoj unanimously embraced the Overclan and each other as their new family.

description.text:
当大理石首氏族征服阿加特巴尔，这座最辉煌之城时，他们从那里的公会和图书馆，尤其是阿加特巴尔大图书馆，获取了很多知识。然而，这些发现并未满足那些永远充满好奇的地精学者，他们宣称必须揭开布勒瓦尔所有的秘密与谜团。

为实现这一目标，地精学者说服当地的布勒瓦尔人协助他们寻找并挖掘古老的巨灵遗迹——人们普遍认为那里藏有大量魔法遗物。起初，巴哈尔人反对这一计划，认为这不过是掠夺，但在确认地精愿意不使用任何爆炸物后，人类最终接受了合作。古老的布勒瓦尔智慧和地精学者与奇械术士的新思想相结合，显著加快了巴哈尔的科学发展进程。
description.text_en:
When the clan of Marblehead took over the most magnificent city of Aqatbar they gained much knowledge from its guilds and libraries, especially the Great Library of Aqatbar. The knowledge found there however did not satisfy the ever-curious goblins scholars, who have declared they must uncover all secrets and mysteries of Bulwar.

As part of this goal, goblin scholars convinced local Bulwari to help them find and excavate ancient genie sites, commonly believed to hold many magical relics. While initially the Bahari were opposed to what they saw as mere looting, the humans eventually accepted, after convincing the goblins to avoid using any explosives. Combined together, ancient Bulwari knowledge and new ideas of goblin scholars and artificers have significantly improved the rate of scientific progress in Bahar.

description.text:
巴哈尔的重组过程漫长，大氏族全面改革了巴哈尔的行政体系，在确保地精完全掌权的同时，也赋予非地精种族政治权力。然而，为了做到这一点，地精需要弥补大流亡所造成的伤害，这个过程长达37年，被后世称为卅年复兴。

虽然卅年复兴主要关注修复被夷为平地的建筑、振兴旧农场和再安置废弃村庄，但它的主要目的还是说服巴哈尔的其他种族接受地精的统治。最初的几个目标相对容易实现，但种族融合遇到了严重的阻力。而沃尔托季，也就是半地精，成为了问题的解决方案。

随着由孤儿组成的新官僚机构的建立，沃尔托季成为大氏族行政机构中不可或缺的组成部分，并积极参与了卅年复兴。巴哈尔人更喜欢和看起来更像人类的沃尔托季合作，而不是地精。发觉这点后，大氏族决定把几乎所有的种族融合计划都委派给沃尔托季。正如预期的那样，沃尔托季在与其他种族建立良好关系方面付出了明显的努力，这又进一步提升了他们在大氏族的地位，因为他们被视为大氏族种族融合理念的象征。
description.text_en:
Reorganisation of Bahar was a long process which saw the Overclan fully overhaul the administration of Bahar, in a way that granted non-goblins political power while goblins fully in charge. In order to do that however goblins needed to atone for the damage caused by their Exodus. That was done with a 37 year long process known as the Decades of Restoration.

While primarily Decades of Restoration focused on restoring razed buildings, rejuvenating old farms and resettling abandoned villages, its primary function was to convince other races of Bahar to accept goblin rule. The first few goals were achieved relatively easily, but the racial integration saw heavy resistance. The solution came in a form of Voltoj.

Following the creation of a new bureaucracy made out of orphans, half-goblins became an integral part of the Overclan administration and actively participated in the Decades of Restoration. Local Bahari preferred working with more humane looking Voltoj than goblins. Seeing this, the Overclan decided to nearly entirely transfer the integration part of the program to the half-goblins. As expected, half-goblins made considerably better effort in securing good relations with other races, further increasing their standing within the Overclan as they were seen as a thematic representation of Overclan's racial syncretism.

description.text: 戈莫抵达阿加特巴尔后，大批坎诺奇械术士也来到此处，了解地精的发明，并帮助他们完善。不出所料，他们最感兴趣的发明是太阳质和地精火。他们细致地研究这些奇怪的武器，让布勒瓦尔其他地方恐惧的是，他们竟然还改进了这些武器。奇械术士将火焰喷射器与地精火结合在一起，通过在喷射器的喷嘴、管道和火焰工兵的盔甲上添加魔法护罩来承受持续喷射太阳质的高温，从而创造出一种威力骇人的死亡喷射器。这种武器被命名为伪阳，因其释放时的毁灭性火力堪比太阳。
description.text_en: Upon the Gommo's arrival to Aqatbar, flocks of artificers from Cannor came to its lands to learn about the goblins' inventions and help perfect them. As expected, the inventions that intrigued them the most were Sunplasm and Goblinfire. They meticulously studied these odd weapons, and to the horror of the rest of Bulwar, actually improved them. They combined the flamethrower with Goblinfire and created a terrifyingly powerful spewer of death that shoots Sunplasm by adding magical wards to the nozzle, pipe, and Flame Sapper armor so that it could withstand the heat of a constant stream of sunplasm. They were named False-Suns, after the incredibly destructive power that the weapon released.

description.text:
由于地理邻近、布西拉尔人与克拉萨诺人之间的文化纽带以及普遍的贸易路线，巴哈尔与布西诺尔始终紧密相连，因此揭秘教在布西拉尔传播后不久，便也传入了巴哈尔。尽管巴哈尔地精早已采用某种基础的奇械术，但巴哈尔的其他种族却对接受这种新的魔法更为犹豫。

大氏族传统上奉行宗教中立政策，但揭秘教的出现被其视为将全巴哈尔统一于单一信仰之下的方式。政府开始大力推广揭秘教，然而，揭秘教仅在地精中流行起来，几乎所有剩余的萨满教徒都选择皈依。这也鼓励了坎诺奇械术士迁居巴哈尔。自此，大氏族与坎诺的关系变得更加紧密，奇械术在巴哈尔的传播也显著加速。
description.text_en:
Bahar and Businor have always been closely connected to each other due to geographical proximity, cultural ties between Busilari and Crathánori humans and general trade routes. Soon after Ravelianism spread throughout Busilar it made its way to Bahar as well. While the goblins of Bahar have been performing some basic artificery for years, other races of Bahar were much more reluctant to accept this new way of magic.

Traditionally, the Overclan held a policy of religious indifference, but the appearance of Ravelianism was seen as a way to unify all people of Bahar under a single faith. The religion and conversion to it were heavily promoted by the government. Yet Ravelianism only became popular with goblins, with nearly all remaining shamanists having chosen to convert and adopt Ravelian teachings and encouraging Cannorian artificers to move to Bahar. Overclan has since seen greater ties with Cannor and an overall increased spread of artificery in Bahar as a whole.

effects.label_zh: 奇械术士军团上限占比

description.text: 大理石首是第一个到达巴哈尔的地精部落，但他们没有在该地区发动征服战争，而是最初在大理石门入口附近定居，并派出了大量的突袭队越过已经荒凉的巴哈尔。巴哈尔农民已经遭受了廿年灾难，他们几乎无法抵抗地精，这让他们能够收集整个地区剩下的任何战利品。在随后的几十年里，人类一直称这个部落为大掠夺者，某种意义上，很多地精都喜欢这样。
description.text_en: Marblehead was the first goblin tribe to arrive in Bahar, but instead of waging wars of conquest around the region they initially settled near the entrance to Shazstundihr and sent out numerous raiding parties across the already desolated Bahar. Bahari peasants who have already suffered from the Decades of Devastation could offer little to no resistance to the goblins, allowing them to gather whatever loot was left in the entire region. Humans kept calling this tribe the great looters for the decades that followed, something that many goblins enjoyed.

description.text: 在被科尔古斯·杜坎森赶走之前，最终入侵巴哈尔的地精们按照地精的标准是一个相当军事化的组织。根据罗祆商人自己的说法，他们的社会提倡严格的纪律和对部落的忠诚，其程度堪比罗祆的大地精。即使在他们定居在巴哈尔之后，古代的许多军事传统仍在地精社会中延续。
description.text_en: Before being forced into exodus by Korgus Dookanson the goblins who would eventually invade Bahar were a fairly militarized group by goblin standards. Their society promoted strict discipline and loyalty to the tribe to a degree comparable to that of Raheni hobgoblins, according to Raheni merchants themselves. Many of the military traditions of the days of old persisted in goblin society even after they settled in Bahar.

description.text: 大理石首的地精是第一批流亡的地精，他们明白教育的价值，并花了相当大的努力为一些高级人员提供教育。阿加特巴尔的第一所地精学校是由现任统治者佩尔祖克在1464年建立的，他雇佣了几位当地的人类教师来教育地精历史、神学和语言。
description.text_en: Goblins of Marblehead were the first exodus goblins to understand the value of education and spent considerable effort providing education to some of its high ranking individuals. The first goblin school of Aqatbar was established in 1464 by its current ruler Perzuk who hired several local human teachers to educate goblins in history, theology and language.

description.text: 虽然大多数地精并不关心他们臣民的宗教信仰，但大理石首更进一步，在他们的国家实施了一项官方的宗教不干涉政策，允许当地人类崇拜苏雷尔，崇敬精灵，前提是他们必须缴纳「太阳税」。
description.text_en: While most goblins care not for the religious beliefs of their subjects, Marblehead went one step further and implemented an official policy of religious non-interference in their state, allowing local humans to worship Surael and venerate the elves, granted they pay the obligatory 'Sun Tax'.

description.text: 当地精们第一次进入阿加特巴尔时，他们被图书馆的规模和内容惊呆了。图书馆收藏了大量的历史文献、科学和宗教文献等。经过多年的翻译，地精们开始创作自己的论文，不断扩大图书馆的规模，目标是让它包含世界上所有的知识。
description.text_en: When goblins first entered Aqatbar, they were stunned by the size and contents of its library. The library contained a large collection of historical documents, scientific and religious texts and more. After spending years translating them, goblins started producing their own papers, expanding the library with the goal of making it contain all the knowledge in the world.

description.text: 在与巴哈尔坎德的战争之后，地精征服了阿加特巴尔要塞。它在巴哈尔的优势地位并没有被地精们忽视，他们将资源转移到新首都，并在此后的数年里继续围绕阿加特巴尔实行中央集权政策。这使得这座城市不仅因为新征服的土地而变得更加富有，而且更完全地融入了大理石首，在几十年的时间里，这座城市变成了主要的地精城市。
description.text_en: Following their war with Baharkand, goblins have conquered the fortress of Aqatbar. Its advantageous position in Bahar did not go unnoticed by the goblins, who pulled their resources towards the new capital and continued the policy of centralisation around Aqatbar for years since. This resulted in the city both growing richer from newly conquered lands and more fully integrated into Marblehead as a whole, with the city becoming predominantly goblin in a few decades.

description.text: 为了分散民众对地精统治的不满，大理石首努力消除自己的入侵和廿年灾难的影响。其中一个实现的想法是，首先参与当地的传统和宴会，后来甚至把它们作为一个整体融入地精社会。
description.text_en: In order to distract the common population of their grievances against goblin rule, Marblehead worked hard to undo the damage of their own invasion and the Decades of Devastation. One of the implemented ideas was at first participating in local traditions and feasts, and later even integrating them in goblin society as a whole.

description.text: 陆鲨是流亡地精中的一员，他们选择通过西路逃离兽人。尽管打败了人类军队，他们的南界堡大要塞迫使我们找到另一条逃跑的道路。后来成为拥山者氏族的同胞们选择了山路，我们选择了海路。我们的临时舰队，尽管损失惨重，还是成功地在南大边区占领了我们的家园。我们永远不会忘记我们的同胞们所做出的牺牲。也不会忘记准备不足的代价。
description.text_en: Landshark is part of the group of Exodus goblins who chose to flee from the Orcs via the western route. Despite defeating the human armies, their great citadel of Bal Ouord forced us to find an alternate path to flee. Our brethren who would become the Mountainhugger Clan chose the mountains, we chose the sea. Our makeshift fleet, despite many losses, was able to conquer us a home in the South Overmarch. We will never forget the sacrifices of our brethren. Nor the cost of being unprepared.

description.text: 我们的许多地精同伴都不像我们一样能幸运地逃离兽人。他们在杜坎森死后逃往这片土地是确保我们地位的关键。我们应该向更多的北方难民开放，让他们在我们的土地上定居。
description.text_en: Many of our fellow goblins were not so lucky as we to flee from the Orcs. Their own exodus to these lands after Dookanson's death was a critical part of securing our position. We should be open to more northern refugees to further settle our lands.

description.text: 人类是比兽人更好的邻居。他们可能不喜欢我们，但当涉及到金钱时，他们愿意忽视种族仇恨等问题。确保我们未来安全的方法是与人类交易，而不是与他们战斗。
description.text_en: Humans make much better neighbors than orcs. They may not like us, but they're willing to overlook such things as racial enmity when it comes to money. The way to secure our future safety is to trade with the humans, not to fight them.

description.text: 他们说鲨鱼能在几里外感觉到潜在猎物哪怕是最小的伤口。我们舰上的炮手在攻击目标时也可以这样做。
description.text_en: They say that sharks can sense even the smallest wound in potential prey from miles away. Our ship's gunners can certainly do the same when it comes to their targets.

description.text: 在寻求被人类接受的过程中，我们放弃了原本可以征服他们的可能。有人可能会说，这让我们变得更弱。说这种话的人是傻瓜。真正的力量来自合作。我们的朋友和盟友会比一个被征服的帝国更能保护我们。
description.text_en: By seeking acceptance from humans, we have forgone the potential conquest we could have done against them. Some might say that this has made us weaker than we could be. Those who would say such things are fools. True strength is found in cooperation. Our friends and allies will protect us far more than a conquered empire ever could.

description.text: 《赫拉金托穆兹（海与堡的故事）》，是由传说中的地精诗人「无鼻者」佐佐克创作的一首史诗。这首诗讲述了两个地精恋人，莫奇博娅和德拉姆科尔克，他们的旅程使他们站在了流亡地精和穿过乌德湾最重要的人物的一边。这首诗在坎诺知识界引起了轩然大波，最终它的一部分被表演为流行戏剧，积极地影响了人类对地精看法，并给陆鲨氏族带来了一部值得骄傲的国家史诗。
description.text_en: The Hradintomuz, the Story of the Fort and the Sea, is an epic poem produced by the legendary goblin poet Zozzok the Noseless. The poem follows two goblin lovers, Motchenboa and Dramkork, as their journey puts them at the side of the most important figures of the goblin exodus and the subsequent crossing of Ouordi gulf. The poem made waves among the Cannorian intellectual community and eventually parts of it were being performed as popular plays, helping positively influence human opinion of goblins and giving the Landshark clan a national epic to be proud of.

description.text: 地精的商品可能有廉价和劣质的名声，但地精奇械术士的创造力给了它们一个新的名声。那就是过火。有眼光的顾客都知道，只有地精自制的自燃炉才有50多种不同的设置，至少有5个旋钮，还有毛绒皮革座椅。
description.text_en: Goblin goods may have a reputation for being cheap and shoddy, but the inventiveness of Goblin artificers has given them a new reputation. That of overkill. Discerning customers know that only a goblin-made self-kindling stove comes with over fifty different settings, at least five knobs, and plush leather seating.

description.text: 灰羊部落是最后一个入侵布勒瓦尔的流亡地精部落，他们在廿年灾难的末期来到这里。此时，布勒瓦尔人和精灵已经面对过地精了，他们更加谨慎，不愿与地精战斗。看到他们对地精的恐惧，部落里充满了骄傲，几十年来，他们一直是这个地区恐惧的根源。
description.text_en: The tribe of Greysheep was the last Exodus goblin tribe to invade Bulwar, arriving at the very end of the Decades of Devastation. By that time the Bulwari and elves had already faced goblins before, and were more cautious and unwilling to fight them. Seeing how feared the goblins were already filled the tribe with pride, with the idea of them being the cause of fear in the region persisting for decades.

description.text: 当其他地精忙于征服巴哈尔的富裕城市时，灰羊却在布勒瓦尔的山坡上定居下来，更专注于放牧他们的牛羊。这个部落已经成为布勒瓦尔最不好战的地精部落，取而代之的是享受工作和建造新家的时光。
description.text_en: While other goblins were busy focusing on conquering rich cities of Bahar, Greysheep instead settled along hills of Bulwar and focused more on herding their sheep and cattle. The tribe had become the least warlike goblin tribe in Bulwar, instead enjoying the time they spent working and developing their new home.

description.text: 不像其他的地精部落会被兽人出没的据点从蛇脊分割出来，灰羊可以通过他们最初出现的洞穴直接进入蛇脊。随着杜坎森的死亡，更多的地精选择离开山脉，并跟随最初的流亡方向，导致灰羊部落有一个稳定从洞穴到达的新地精人口。
description.text_en: Unlike other goblin tribes who are separated from the Serpentspine by the orc infested holds, Greysheep has a direct access via the caves they initially emerged from. Following the death of Dookanson many more goblins chose to leave the mountains and followed the direction the original exodus went, resulting in Greysheep tribe having a steady supply of new goblins arriving from the caves.

description.text: 「旅行者」弗拉赫是一名地精探险家和旅行家，他受他的人民的流亡的启发，去更远的地精从未去过的地方。他于1440年从灰羊出发，游历了布勒瓦尔的大部分地区、萨拉哈德沙漠，甚至罗祆的部分地区。在经过多年的长途旅行回到家后，他把自己的遭遇和经历编成了一本书，这本书在地精中非常受欢迎。这本书特别描述了其他种族的各种习俗和传统，灰羊部落认为这些在进行外交时很有用。
description.text_en: Frax the Traveler was a goblin explorer and adventurer who was inspired by his peoples' exodus to travel further where no goblin has ever been. He set out from Greysheep in 1440 and traveled around much of Bulwar, Salahad desert and even parts of Rahen. Upon coming back home from his years long journey he collected his encounters and experiences into a book which became immensely popular among goblins. The book specifically described various customs and traditions of other races, which the tribe of Greysheep found useful when conducting diplomacy.

description.text: 大灰羊是一种特殊的羊品种，只有在地精定居的山上才有。它们比杰勒卡利斯的同类要大得多，更笨重更强壮，甚至能载着地精的情况下全速奔跑。地精在15世纪晚期开始使用他们作为骑兵，一开始让巴哈尔人感到惊讶，然后让他们感到害怕，因为他们看到一群地精在灰色的绵羊上冲锋。
description.text_en: The Big Grey Sheep is a peculiar breed of sheep unique to goblin settled hills. Much larger compared to their Gelkalis counterparts they are bulkier and stronger, even capable of running full speed with a goblin on top. Goblins started using them as cavalry in late 15th century, first surprising and then scaring Bahari humans with the unusual sight of a goblin horde charging on top of grey sheep.

description.text: 不像其他的流亡部落喜欢攻击他们的敌人，灰羊地精更喜欢让他们的敌人来找他们。他们的土地上布满了陷阱、小型营地和武器储存箱，让地精能够在穿越山丘时不断攻击敌人。
description.text_en: Unlike other exodus tribes who prefer attacking their enemies, goblins of Greysheep instead prefer letting their enemies come to them. Their lands are filled with traps, small encampments and weapon caches, allowing goblins to continually attack their enemies as they advance through the hills.

description.text: 灰羊地精用自己的羊毛制作了一些最好看的地精服装，至少他们自己是这么认为的。甚至在部落失去主权后很长一段时间，布勒瓦尔北部的地精继续制作服装，这种衣服甚至在布勒瓦尔以外的地方也很流行。来自拜韦克和梅斯季卡尔杜的富商和寡头们会不断地向他们要求新的服装系列，并支付一大笔钱来保持衣服的供应。
description.text_en: Using wool from their sheep Greysheep goblins created some of the best looking goblinic clothing, at least according to the goblins themselves. Even long after the tribe had lost its sovereignty the goblins of northern Bulwar continued making clothes which became popular even outside of Bulwar. Rich merchants and oligarchs from Bayvek and Mestikardu would constantly demand new collections from them, paying a large sum of money to keep the clothes coming.

description.text:
拥山者是流亡地精中的一员，他们选择通过西路逃离兽人。尽管打败了人类军队，他们的南界堡大要塞迫使我们找到另一条逃跑的道路。后来成为陆鲨家族的同胞们选择了海路，我们选择了山路。这条山路险象环生，寒冷、饥饿、野兽潜伏的危险和险象环生的地形中杀死了我们许多人。

当我们最终到达巴哈尔时，我们的人数严重减少。利用由当地民兵和冒险者组成的当地人类军队，我们成功地打败了矮人、人类和精灵，并为自己开辟了一个新的家园。通过这次翻山越岭和以后的战斗，我们可以学到许多如何在逆境中保存我们的军队，以及如何更好地利用我们多样化的军队。
description.text_en:
Mountainhugger is part of the group of Exodus goblins who chose to flee from the Orcs via the western route. Despite defeating the human armies, their great citadel of Bal Ouord forced us to find an alternate path to flee. Our brethren who would become the Landshark Clan chose the sea, we chose the mountains. The crossing was treacherous and deadly, killing many of our number through cold, starvation, and the hidden dangers of beasts and treacherous terrain.

When we finally got to Bahar, our numbers were severely reduced. Utilizing local human troops made up of local militia and unscrupulous adventurers, we managed to defeat the Dwarves, Humans, and Elves of the region and carve ourselves a new home. By studying the mountain crossing and subsequent battles, we can learn many lessons in how to preserve our forces in adversity and also how to best utilize our diverse troops.

description.text: 与我们现在称之为家园的新土地相比，我们曾经居住的洞穴是天壤之别。虽然洞穴是一个天堂，靠近大地母亲的心脏，有大量的蘑菇可供每个人食用，但地面是一片明亮而严酷的景观，人们的眼睛被迫与天空中一个巨大而残酷的宝石作斗争，它杀死了我们的主要食物来源，让我们吃奇怪的黄色植物，种子几乎不能吃，还有覆盖着大量毛发的陌生肉类。有许多人想要返回，他们看不到这片土地的潜力，如果不是他们自己的本能和寻找我们新征服土地上皇冠上的宝石：黄金，从山腰和旱地交汇处的矿井中涌出的几乎永无止境的溪流，的动力，也许他们现在已经返回了。
description.text_en: The caves we once populated are a far cry when compared to the new lands we now call our home. While the caves were a haven, close to the heart of mother earth, and vast, with plenty of mushrooms to go around for everyone, the surface is a bright and harsh landscape, where one’s eyes are forced to contend with a great and cruel gemstone in the sky, one that kills our main source of food, leaving us to eat strange yellow plants with nearly inedible seeds, and unfamiliar meats covered in cumbersome amounts of hair. There are many of those who want to return, who do not see the potential in these lands, and perhaps they would have returned by now… if it weren’t for their own basal instincts and drive to seek out the crown jewel of our newly conquered lands: gold, a nearly-neverending stream from the mines where mountainside and dryland meet.

description.text: 在我们的下层阶级中，牧羊几乎是无处不在的，使用投石索也是如此。用投石索来抵御危险的动物攻击我们的牧群，在拥山者社会中，使用投石索的技能是非常受尊重的。村庄经常举行比赛，看谁能击中最难的目标，最负盛名的比赛吸引了来自我国领土最偏远地区的观众和参与者。当我们的士兵被叫去打仗时，他们带着经过多年训练的枪法。无论是用投石索还是用枪，我们的步兵都有致命的准确性。
description.text_en: Shepherding is near ubiquitous among our lower classes, and so is the use of the sling. Used to fend off dangerous animals from attacking our herds, skill with the sling is highly honored in Mountainhugger society. Villages hold frequent competitions to see who can hit the hardest targets, with the most prestigious competitions drawing spectators and participants from the farthest reaches of our territory. When our soldiers are called to war, they bring marksmanship skills honed by years of practice. Whether fighting with slings or guns, our infantry are capable of deadly accuracy.

description.text: 在历史上的大部分时间里，巴哈尔的铸币厂都在我们永恒的对手——矮人的手中，在一个邪恶的系统中，其时间和矮人到来的时间一样长，在闪亮的光泽下掩盖的一个贪婪的剥削系统，这个系统欺骗了整个大陆几个世纪。这是无法忍受的，这就是为什么我们地精要通过控制巴哈尔的金矿来结束他们的剥削，让我们用自己的货币有效地取代他们的货币暴政。
description.text_en: For much of its history, Bahari mintage was within the hands of our eternal rivals - the dwarves - in an unholy system that was as dwarven as they came, masking an exploitative system of greed beneath a shiny sheen that has duped a whole continent for centuries. It was intolerable, which is why we goblins deigned to end their exploitation by controlling Bahar’s gold mines, allowing us to effectively replace their monetary tyranny with our own.

description.text: 在地精的历史中，巨大水体的概念是完全陌生的。是的，地下有水池和溪流，但像地面上的人利用「迪文哈尔海」那样利用它们几乎是闻所未闻的。这就是它一直存在的方式，直到我们了解到，由于对巴哈尔海岸沿海定居点和航行中的船只的掠夺，以及地精的贪婪，带来了未开发的财富。地精海盗以成群结队的船只而臭名昭著——他们嘴里含着刀，后面跟着装有重新设计的滑轮和起重机的大驳船。幸运的驳船会被发现空无一人，只有被洗干净的尸体和被冲上岸的贵重物品，不幸的驳船会被征用，驶进原来的港口，充当地精突袭的前线。
description.text_en: For much of goblin history, the concept of a giant body of water was completely alien. Pools and streams existed underground, yes, but to use them the way the people of the surface use the ‘Divenhal’ is almost completely unheard of. And that’s how it would remain, until our kind learned of the untapped riches that came with the plundering of coastal settlements on the Bahari coastline and boats in the middle of voyages, borne of observation and goblin greed. Goblin pirates would be infamous for swarming boats by the dozen - armed with knives in their mouths and trailed by great barges with refashioned pulleys and cranes. Lucky barges would be found empty, with nothing but bodies picked clean of valuables washing ashore, the unfortunate ones would be commandeered and sailed into their original ports, serving as the front for a goblin raid.

description.text: 地精看重能力，而不是高贵的教养或所谓的神圣任命。布勒瓦尔最优秀和最聪明的人类自然会发现我们的土地对就业更有吸引力，因为这帮助我们的政府雇用最好的人，而不需要提供像我们邻国一样多的东西。
description.text_en: Goblins value ability, not noble upbringing or supposed divine appointment. The best and brightest humans of Bulwar naturally find our lands more attractive for employment because of this, helping our administration employ the best without needing to offer as much as our neighbour states.

name.text: 用更少的钱得到最好的东西

description.text: 由拥山者被大氏族吞并后的奇械术士「啰嗦者」普拉克安克设计，普拉克安克的爆炸最佳瞄准测距仪和放大镜允许一个人像用步枪瞄准一样瞄准火炮，同时可以自动调整炮管位置和火炮的火力，以达到难以置信的准确性。当它交到我们熟练的士兵手中时，它一定会使我们的炮兵在战场上成为恐怖的武器。
description.text_en: Created by the artificer Plakeank the Verbose by the time Mountainhugger was absorbed into the Overclan, Plakeank's Rangefinder and Magnifier for the Optimal Aiming of Explosives allows one to aim artillery in the same manner as a rifle, with the device automatically adjusting the barrel position and firing power of the artillery piece to achieve incredible accuracy. When placed in the skilled hands of our soldiers, it will surely make our artillery a terror on the battlefield.

name.text: 普拉克安克的爆炸最佳瞄准测距仪和放大镜
name.text_en: Plakeank's Rangefinder and Magnifier for the Optimal Aiming of Explosives

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想1444直接使用形成国、不愿满足宽容与地区门槛，或不想管理学院、官僚和信仰关系的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期以流亡哥布林整合巴哈尔并取得形成资格；中期铺设学院和多族群行政；后期扩张港口、矿堡与道路，建设魔法—奇械国家。
player_overview.overview: 你先从巴哈尔的外来哥布林氏族起步；只有夺得足够领地、处理多族群宽容并摆脱部落身份，才能成立大氏族。此后你要用半地精官僚和学院经营城市，整合矮人矿堡、鹰身女妖山地与迪文哈尔商路，再把火药、魔法研究和奇械接入军政体系。它的强项是把包容变成治理能力，代价是漫长的形成准备与繁重的行政整合。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢形成国前传、城市经营、多族群治理和魔法与奇械混合玩法的玩家。
signature_features: 形成门槛同时要求领土、政府转型和多个智慧族群的宽容。
半地精与孤儿学院培养官僚，顾问职位持续改变城市成长。
魔法研究、奇械发明与火药军队和跨地区道路相互支撑。
player_overview.tagline: 让流亡的哥布林氏族建成一个多族群、学院化的贸易与奇械国家。

reasons: 形成门槛将多族群宽容直接写成建国资格
沃尔托季学院与顾问职位使城市和官僚成为核心玩法
贸易、道路、魔法与奇械让长期发展不只依赖战争
warnings: 必须同时处理领土和多群体宽容条件
玩家反馈称部分菜单和任务要求不够直观

positive_indicators: 形成决议要求多族群宽容
豺狼人山地任务要求豺狼人宽容、地方职位和议会席位
学院、城市、道路及跨文化议会构成公共建设
values.rationale: 形成门槛与任务实际要求人类、精灵、矮人或鹰身女妖、豺狼人等群体的宽容和政治整合，学院、道路、城市建设服务公共利益；这些是正面制度证据。孤儿与半地精招募在剧情中也被描述为获得无家族忠诚的官僚资源，征服地使用强力治安，降低尊严与克制分。战争、君主制、扩张和一般宗教整合本身不扣分，未把旧DOCX中的心灵控制构想当成当前实装。
red_flags: 孤儿招募文本将缺乏家族忠诚视作国家利益
征服后部分地区使用宣传与强力治安
多元共存仍受到集中官僚权力约束
